steps.t: Work out what I actually need
See what is new and popular
Check it fits what I own
Send it to the brand for repair

needs.t: I want one good pan that does eggs in the morning and a stir-fry at night.
needs.reason: Step 4 directly covers finding the right product for a job before shopping.
needs.evidence: Work out what kind of product does the job I have in mind before I start looking.

needs.t: Do the handles get hot after twenty minutes on the hob?
needs.reason: No step states handle temperature after twenty minutes on the hob; Step 1 only covers general heat limits.

needs.t: Is the hand-hammered copper range worth three times the price of the stainless one, or is it just for show?
needs.reason: It compares features and price but leaves open whether the extra cost is justified or purely cosmetic.
needs.evidence: "Compare two or three options side by side on features and price." and "What is the difference between these models? Which one is better for me?"

needs.t: I'm blind. Can I use this coffee machine without reading the display?
needs.reason: A general "learn to use it" step does not address blindness or using the machine without reading the display.

needs.t: I have arthritis. I need a kettle I can fill, lift and pour without much grip.
needs.reason: The steps cover maintenance, cleaning, compatibility, repair and faults, but not grip or arthritis.

needs.t: What's the real difference between the two espresso machines apart from the steam wand?
needs.reason: Step 1 compares models by features and price and explicitly answers what differs between them.
needs.evidence: Compare two or three options side by side on features and price.

needs.t: Will the blender crush ice for smoothies, or only soft fruit?
needs.reason: No step explicitly tells the customer whether this blender crushes ice.

needs.t: Is the toaster wide enough for sourdough slices?
needs.reason: Step 3 gives overall size for counter space, not the slot width needed for sourdough slices.

needs.t: Which food processor is easy to clean for someone who hates washing up?
needs.reason: Step 1 tells how to clean, but not which food processor is easiest to clean before buying.

needs.t: Will the stand mixer fit under my wall cupboards? I have 45 centimetres of clearance.
needs.reason: Step 1 covers dimensions and explicitly answers whether the mixer will fit the available space.
needs.evidence: Will it fit the space I have?

needs.t: I need a toaster that is easy to see and use with low vision: big buttons, high contrast.
needs.reason: No step explicitly covers low-vision needs like big buttons or high contrast, and disability needs are rarely met by general steps.

needs.t: Are the replacement filters still sold for last year's kettle?
needs.reason: Step 1 mentions buying filters but does not confirm they are still sold for last year's model.
needs.evidence: Buy spare parts, replacement cushions, filters or accessories for it.
needs.missing: Check spares for last year's kettle

needs.t: I need a wedding present from their list, under a hundred pounds, that will still be in their kitchen in ten years.
needs.reason: It covers gifts and budget but omits the registry list and ten-year lifespan.
needs.evidence: Find a gift for someone else within a budget.

needs.t: My dad has just retired and wants to learn to cook. Where do I even start?
needs.reason: Step 3 covers where to start shopping, not where to start learning to cook.

needs.t: What's new this season? Nothing in mind, just looking.
needs.reason: Step 1 explicitly shows new arrivals and directly answers what is new.
needs.evidence: See new arrivals, best sellers and what other people are buying. Questions it answers: What is new?

needs.t: Is there a bundle that works out cheaper than the machine and grinder separately?
needs.reason: Step 1 mentions bundle offers but does not explicitly compare the bundle price to separate prices.
needs.evidence: Check the price, any sale, discount or bundle offer.

needs.t: Will it arrive before Saturday if I order today?
needs.reason: Step 1 explicitly lets the customer check how quickly it will arrive before committing.
needs.evidence: Check delivery cost and how quickly it will arrive before deciding.

needs.t: Can I return a gift if they already have one, without them seeing the price?
needs.reason: The return step only covers ordinary refunds, not gifts, duplicates, or hidden prices.

needs.t: Can I talk to someone who knows the products? I don't know what I need.
needs.reason: Step 3 is only general contact, not a product expert who can advise an unsure customer.
needs.evidence: Ask the shop a question before buying and get an answer.

needs.t: The green colour is out of stock in this size. Will it come back?
needs.reason: Step 1 only tells if it is in stock now, not if it will be restocked later.

needs.t: I want to send it straight to the couple with a gift note and no price inside.
needs.reason: It covers delivery to the couple but leaves the gift note and no-price requirements unanswered.
needs.evidence: Enter the delivery address and contact details. Questions it answers: Where should it be delivered, and to whom?
needs.missing: Add gift note and hide price

needs.t: My discount code says it's invalid but the email says it runs until Sunday.
needs.reason: It covers invalid codes generally but does not explain why it fails before the Sunday expiry date.
needs.evidence: "Why does my code not work?"

needs.t: Can I pay for the espresso machine in instalments without a credit check?
needs.reason: Step 3 only lets the customer ask a question; it does not state whether instalments without a credit check are available
needs.evidence: Ask the shop a question before buying and get an answer

needs.t: Can I change the pan size after I've placed the order?
needs.reason: It offers size swaps but does not confirm they can be made after placing the order.
needs.evidence: Exchange it for a different size or colour.

needs.t: The error message says something is wrong but not which field.
needs.reason: Step 5 explains general faults but never identifies which field caused the error message.

needs.t: How do I set up the grinder? The instructions are only pictures.
needs.reason: Step 2 directly covers first-time setup, which is exactly what the customer asks.
needs.evidence: Unbox the product and set it up for the first time.

needs.t: My cast-iron pan has gone rusty after the dishwasher. Can I save it?
needs.reason: Step 5 lets the customer fix damage themselves and buy the products needed to save the pan.
needs.evidence: Can I fix this myself, and what do I need to buy?

needs.t: My espresso tastes sour. Is it the beans, the grind or the machine?
needs.reason: Step 1 covers wear, marks or faults, not coffee taste or beans, grind and machine causes

needs.t: The enamel on the casserole has chipped. Is it still safe to cook in?
needs.reason: Step 1 covers coatings and safety generally, not whether a chip makes it unsafe to cook in.
needs.missing: Check if chipped enamel is safe

needs.t: My grandmother left me her copper pans. Can they be re-tinned, and what would it cost?
needs.reason: Step 1 offers a repair quote but does not confirm re-tinning for copper pans.
needs.evidence: get a quote and a timescale

needs.t: Time to reorder the water filters. Same ones as last time.
needs.reason: Step 1 explicitly lets the customer buy the same thing again quickly, directly matching the need to reorder identical filters.
needs.evidence: Buy the same thing again quickly.

needs.t: I lost the receipt. Is the guarantee still valid?
needs.reason: Step 1 covers warranty cover but says nothing about missing receipts or proof of purchase
needs.evidence: Is this covered by the guarantee?

needs.t: How do I dispose of an old toaster safely? Can it go in the bin?
needs.reason: Step 1 directly covers safe end-of-life disposal and recycling, answering both the disposal method and whether it can go in the bin.
needs.evidence: Dispose of or recycle it at the end of its life. Questions it answers: How do I get rid of it safely or recycle it?

needs.t: I'm selling my copper set second-hand. How do I prove it's genuine?
needs.reason: No step explains how to prove genuineness; valuation and material checks are not authenticity proof.

needs.t: The return label needs a printer and I don't have one.
needs.reason: No step mentions printer-free returns, QR codes, drop-off, or any alternative to a printed label.

needs.t: My son wants to learn proper latte art. Is there a beginner's guide?
needs.reason: Step 1 gives general usage guides, not a latte-art beginner's guide.
needs.evidence: Learn how to use it properly from instructions or a video.

needs.t: How often should I season the cast-iron pan, and with what oil?
needs.reason: Step 1 only shares the topic of seasoning, not the specific schedule or oil needed.
needs.missing: Check seasoning frequency and oil type

needs.t: The food processor has started smelling of burning. Is it safe to use?
needs.reason: No step tells the customer whether a burning smell means the appliance is unsafe to use.

needs.t: The product photos have no descriptions, so my screen reader just says 'image'. What does the kettle look like?
needs.reason: No step provides a text description of product images for screen-reader users.

needs.t: The delivery driver only rings once and I can't get to the door quickly. Can they wait or leave it with a neighbour?
needs.reason: No step covers the driver waiting or leaving with a neighbour; they only cover cost, timing, tracking, speed, address, or repair.
